note: Both sets are virtually identical, extracting the same four claims with matching values, conditions, and quotes. Both correctly capture the torque formulas and the inverse proportionality relationship. However, both sets fail to accurately transcribe the derivative term in the PID control law (Equation 7-10), omitting the dot over Delta Omega and the upper limit 't' on the integral. Since the errors and correct extractions are identical, the sets are of equal quality.
